name: Brumal-Drumlin
description: Cold has crystallized everything here into geometry: dune-fields of frost, canyons of clear blue ice, and far off, past a tidally locked hemisphere, a light that lingers blue long after sunset.
The air carries burnt sugar and sulfur, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts.
Instruments disagree about the radiation hotspot: mass reads one value, inertia another. Probes sent in return transmitting their own launch signals, timestamped hours early.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
